Zoe (People Ops): quick thread to answer a few manager Qs about internal transfers, evidence hosting size limits, and retro pay timing.
Aiden (Eng Manager): if someone transfers between teams during the cycle, what's the minimal action to keep their promo packet valid?
Zoe (People Ops): update manager of record in Workday before the evidence cutoff and use the evidence-transfer form. if both managers sign off before cutoff we keep the original timestamps. link: https://intranet.redwood.com/tools/evidence-transfer
Aiden (Eng Manager): evidence size: some demos are 1GB. preferred hosting?
Sam (Hiring Ops): use the company shared drive or the playbook repo attachments. avoid personal Google Drives. for large recordings, upload to shared drive and include a short timestamped clip and summary. recommended per-file max 500MB.
Rae (Compensation): for calibration please include 2 concise impact bullets per artifact. panels skip long transcripts.
Aiden (Eng Manager): retro pay timing: if payroll cutoff is missed, how long until the employee sees retro?
Maya (Payroll): retro is processed the next payroll cycle; typically appears in 1-2 pay cycles depending on timing and benefits deductions. we need signed comp-change + approvals to start processing.
Aiden (Eng Manager): any special note for international transfers?
Zoe (People Ops): confirm local employment records update and loop Legal for countries with strict effective date limits. EMEA payroll calendars vary; cc payroll early.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: "Evidence cutoff & manager-of-record update" on 2025-09-10 09:00 PT.
Zoe (People Ops): i'll post a 1-page checklist to #people-ops-resources and a small sample evidence clip template. ping me for pre-review before you submit. :white_check_mark:
